name: HomeAssistant_inabox
description: REPLACED BY HOME ASSISTANT INABOX V3. Install "HomeAssistant_inabox_v3" from Community Applications instead. This version is no longer developed. Your Home Assistant VM is not affected by any of this. It belongs to Unraid's VM manager, not to this container, so it keeps running whatever you do here - including deleting this container. **Moving to v3** Install HomeAssistant_inabox_v3 from Community Applications, open it and check your existing Home Assistant VM appears on its page, then delete this old container. v3 finds Home Assistant VMs you already have by reading the VM's own disk, so an install made by this container is recognised automatically, even while it is switched off. Unraid does not update Docker templates when a container image updates, so updating this container will not move you to v3 on its own. It will start in a notice mode that explains what has happened and where to go. Nothing is damaged by that, and your VM carries on running throughout. **Staying on v2 for now** If you are not ready to move, change this template's Repository field to `spaceinvaderone/ha_inabox:2` and restart the container. That tag is frozen at the final v2 release and will keep working exactly as it does today. --- What this container did: downloaded, installed and managed a Home Assistant VM on your Unraid server, restarting the VM if it was found stopped, and redirecting this container's WebUI to the Home Assistant VM's own WebUI.
